purpose_en: A decomposed mixture of farm-animal dung and urine with litter and leftover fodder, applied as an organic manure.
purpose_ta: கால்நடைகளின் சாணம், சிறுநீர், படுக்கைக் கழிவு மற்றும் மீதமுள்ள தீவனம் மட்கிய கலவை; இயற்கை உரமாக இடப்படுகிறது.

key_points: "On an average well decomposed farmyard manure contains 0.5 per cent N, 0.2 per cent P2O5 and 0.5 per cent K2O."
Prepared in trenches of about 6-7.5 m × 1.5-2.0 m × 1.0 m, filled, then domed and plastered with cow dung-earth slurry; ready in about four to five months
"Generally 10 to 20 t/ha is applied, but more than 20 t/ha is applied to fodder grasses and vegetables."

source_organization: Tamil Nadu Agricultural University (TNAU) Agritech Portal
